text: alex: heads up — mkdocs build failed on CI for the website. TOC build step errors with 'unexpected end of input' in html parsing. Repro link: https://builds.redwood/ci/4532/log :facepalm: maria: which page? i saw quickstart had weird render but didn't break locally alex: quickstart.md — code block with inline backticks in the example ends up as a trailing backtick in generated HTML: `pip install redwood``` — double tick jamie: probable culprit is the SDK snippet generator that wraps examples and escapes backticks badly. i can run the generator locally and inspect maria: can you paste a minimal repro? jamie: sure — minimal snippet: ```python from redwood import Client client = Client() print("hello`") ``` — note the stray backtick in the string literal above — our naive escaping turns it into an extra backtick in the rendered inline code luis: odd. markdown-it-py should handle this. maybe our preprocessor does a replace like `"` -> "``" inside snippet blobs sophie: quick patch idea: skip snippet-escaping when inside fenced code blocks, only escape in inline snippets. pushed draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789 — adds a test and a small guard alex: thanks. CI for the PR shows the new test catches the broken case. docs-bot: build triggered for PR 789 — macos-lint, mkdocs-build docs-bot: mkdocs-build failed on first run (flaky assets fetch), retriggered jamie: merged the fix to the snippet generator and added unit tests. deployed to staging docs build. steps i ran locally: `pytest tests/snippet_escape_test.py && mkdocs build -d site-staging` maria: verified locally — quickstart renders correctly now and TOC generation is stable. :tada: alex: PR merged and staging rebuild passed. closing out this thread. thanks all. sophie: follow-up: opened an issue to add a pre-commit check for unbalanced backticks inside example code blocks: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/154
